extracted.name: Tricia's Fantastic Fudge Pie
extracted.description: This rich and decadent hot fudge pie is perfect for chocolate lovers. Serve it hot with a huge scoop of vanilla ice cream and a sprinkling of nuts on top.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup butter, melted and slightly cooled
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).
Stir sugar, melted butter, eggs, and vanilla together in a bowl.
Mix flour and cocoa powder together in a separate bowl. Pour in wet ingredients and stir until thoroughly combined. Fold in chocolate chips. Pour batter into pie shell.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve hot.
